test_title: English Language and Comprehension Mock Test 77

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.Abhilash doesn’t play tennis anymore, and he doesn’t watch it either, ______________?

Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.A. The thrill comes from the free-fall and the momentary sensation of weightlessness before the cord pulls the jumper back upwards.B. Safety measures, such as checking equipment and having trained professionals, are crucial to ensure a safe and exciting experience.C. Bungee jumping is an extreme sport that involves jumping from a great height while connected to a large elastic cord.D. While some experience a rush of adrenaline, others may feel anxiety or fear during the jump.E. It originated in New Zealand and has become popular worldwide.
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.By next year, she _______ in this company for 8 years.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (will have worked) है।

questions.question: Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given paragraph and select the option that rectifies it.Gilles Deleuze was one of the most original and imaginative thinkers of postwar France. A lifelong teacher, he spent most of his career at the University of Paris VIII, influencing generations of students but largely shouning the mantle of public intellectual.

Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.A) Because of their soothing green colours, emeralds were also said to repair eyesight in ancient times.B) It is said that in ancient Egypt, Cleopatra collected and used them in her most opulent royal adornments.C) Emeralds are the birth stone of May; they embody rebirth, renewal and spring.D) These beautiful green gemstones have been fascinating mankind since ancient times.
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given phrase.A person who studies ancient writings and inscriptions

Select the most appropriate idiom/phrase that can be used as a substitute for the underlined group of words in the given sentence.The community was angry and upset over the construction of the new bridge.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (up in arms) है।

questions.question: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.A. Governments are providing incentives and setting ambitious deadlines for phasing out internal combustion engines.B. However, challenges like charging infrastructure and the environmental impact of battery production remain.C. Electric Vehicles (EVs) are rapidly transforming the automotive industry, with global sales projected to grow by 40% this year.D. Companies like Tesla, BYD and traditional automakers are investing heavily in EV technology.E. The EV revolution is seen as pivotal in reducing global carbon emissions.
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.Even though Nidhi knew the surgery would be extremely painful, she decided to _______ and schedule the surgery.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (bite the bullet) है।

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the highlighted word in the following conversation to fill in the blank.Sebastian: “I felt ____________________ in front of everyone.”Hemant: “Don’t worry, it wasn’t as egregious as you think.”

Comprehension:Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.The Western Pacific Region faces a looming mental health crisis, driven by social pressures, vulnerabilities and unrest, amplified by the wide ranging impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on communities everywhere. Over 215 million people are living with mental health conditions in the Region. Suicide continues to be a leading cause of death among young people, and for every death, there are many more suicide attempts. At the same time, demographic shifts in some countries are increasing the proportion of older people, contributing to the growing prevalence of dementia and other mental health conditions related to ageing.Rapid and unplanned urbanisation give rise to build environments that are not conducive to health and well-being. Economic pressures, toxic online interactions and increased drug use can also cause stress and other direct threats to mental health. Substance use compounds the risk of developing a mental health condition and can lead to risky behaviour, especially among young people. Chronic exposure to adversity due to these and other risk factors increase the likelihood of developing a mental health condition across the life-course.The Region is also home to some of the most climate-vulnerable countries and areas in the world. Extreme weather events and other environmental hazards can lead to large-scale health emergencies and complex humanitarian crises, resulting in widespread mental distress and suffering. Communities residing in small islands and coastal areas are facing an uncertain future due to rising sea levels, leading many to feel anxious and afraid for their way of life.Which of the following most accurately states the main idea of the passage?
